parts.text: I don't know about a specific worst day, but things that worry me include closures coming into force while drones of several companies are already in the air, closures being amended during the day, and batteries draining faster in cold and wind than planned. Radio coverage can be patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, and reports from drones can arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Drones sometimes restart in flight after a software fault and carry on, and links used to give instructions to drones and charging equipment can send instructions twice while the sender cannot tell if the first attempt arrived.
